messages.subject: Tentative Lighthouse session grid — revision 3
messages.body: Please treat the attached Lighthouse grid as tentative revision 3 for Wednesday, October 14 in America/Chicago. Aster kickoff is 09:00–09:30 in Juniper. Boreal review is 10:00–11:00 in Sable. Cinder decision is 11:30–12:00 in Juniper. Dune handoff is 14:30–15:00 in Sable. The workbook is our shared schedule record. Check Signal Quay before confirming anything because the program lead may publish a later revision.

messages.subject: Atrium plant service
messages.body: The atrium planters will be serviced Thursday morning. No Lighthouse rooms are affected.
